answer.reason: The verses tell of his refusal to worship the golden image and his deliverance from the furnace, which the summary does not state.

clauses.english: was cast into the burning fiery furnace for refusing to worship the golden image
clauses.quote: fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace

clauses.english: came out of the furnace unharmed
clauses.quote: upon whose bodies the fire had no power

doubts: The verses name him mostly as Shadrach, the name given him in DAN 1:7; the furnace verses are taken as his.
